section.title: Invite {name}
section.body: Send {name} a code so they can join MyOrbit and look after their own profile.
section.pending: Invite sent {sent}. The code works until {expires}.

screen.title: Invite
screen.heading: Invite {name}
screen.codeNote: Share this code with {name} only. It works once and expires in 14 days. It won't be shown again, but you can always make a new one.
screen.shareFailed: Couldn't open sharing on this device. Copy the message below instead.

join.title: Join with a code
join.body: Got a code from a relative? Enter it here: an invite to join a tree, or a request to link two family trees.
join.claimNote: When you accept, this profile becomes yours: only you can change its details, and you can add relatives to the tree.
join.notMeNote: Then don't accept it. Ask the person who sent the code to check which profile it's for.

errors.invalid: That code doesn't match an invite. Check it and try again.
errors.used: This invite has already been used.
errors.revoked: This invite was cancelled. Ask for a new code.
errors.expired: This invite has expired. Ask for a new code.
errors.tooManyTries: Too many wrong codes. Try again in an hour.
errors.alreadyInTree: You already have a profile in this family tree.
errors.notAllowed: Only owners and editors of the tree can send invites.
errors.blocked_claimed: This profile already belongs to someone.
errors.blocked_minor: Children below the age limit can't be invited. They can claim their profile when they're older.
errors.failed: Something went wrong. Please try again.
